d: Long, flowing mint-green hair with a single thick platinum-white streak and long bangs frames a youthful face with narrow, reddish-orange eyes. A slender build is dressed in a layered black kimono with pink and red accents, worn over a high-collared mint-green shirt featuring a large green dragon tattoo across the chest. Signature details include a tall black traditional headpiece, a vintage teal camera hanging from a strap, and black fingerless gloves paired with long blue pointed nails.
